# huggingface_trusted_publisher (Resource)

Manage exactly one GitHub Actions trusted-publisher binding. Repo/claim changes replace the binding with destroy before create by default. The management API is undocumented; other bindings are preserved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "huggingface_trusted_publisher" "example" {
  repo_id           = huggingface_repository.example.repo_id
  github_repository = "your-github-owner/training"
  branch            = "main"
  workflow          = "publish.yml"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Short branch name, matched as refs/heads/<branch>.
- `github_repository` (String) GitHub owner/repo, matched exactly.
- `repo_id` (String) Target model repository namespace/name.
- `workflow` (String) YAML filename in .github/workflows/.

### Optional

- `repo_type` (String) Only model is supported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import identity model/namespace/name/publisher_id.
- `issuer` (String) GitHub Actions OIDC issuer.
- `publisher_id` (String) Immutable remote binding identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Read-only import. Do not create an existing trust a second time.
tofu import huggingface_trusted_publisher.example model/your-hf-namespace/example-model/publisher_id
```
